title: configure git to fit your hands
goal: D1 Aliases, hooks, ignore rules and the defaults that pay off daily
startWith: Global config — this step follows you to every repository.

newIdeas.plain: A git subcommand you define. git lg is not built in; yours can be.
A script git runs at a lifecycle point: pre-commit, commit-msg, pre-push.
The repo .gitignore, then .git/info/exclude (local, never committed), then the global file.

tasks.do: Add the four aliases you will actually use

blocks.label: terminal
blocks.body:
git config --global alias.lg "log --oneline --graph --decorate --all -20"
git config --global alias.st "status -sb"
git config --global alias.last "log -1 --stat"
git config --global alias.undo "reset --soft HEAD~1"
git lg

tasks.do: Turn on the settings that prevent the common accidents

blocks.label: terminal
blocks.body:
git config --global fetch.prune true
git config --global diff.colorMoved zebra
git config --global merge.conflictstyle zdiff3    # shows the common ancestor too
git config --global push.default current
git config --global core.autocrlf input           # 'false' on Windows-only repos

tasks.do: Ignore files three ways, and untrack one you already committed

blocks.label: terminal
blocks.body:
echo 'target/' >> .gitignore
echo 'scratch.local' >> .git/info/exclude       # local only, never committed
git config --global core.excludesfile ~/.gitignore_global
git rm --cached secrets.env                     # stop tracking, keep the file
git check-ignore -v target/x.class               # why is this ignored?

tasks.do: Add a pre-commit hook that blocks the mistake you actually make
tasks.why: A hook that runs the whole test suite gets bypassed within a week. One that takes 200ms survives.

blocks.label: .git/hooks/pre-commit
blocks.body:
#!/bin/sh
# Refuse commits that stage a conflict marker or a debug print.
if git diff --cached -U0 | grep -nE '^\+.*(<<<<<<<|System\.out\.println\("DEBUG)'; then
  echo "pre-commit: debug or conflict marker staged" >&2
  exit 1
fi

blocks.label: terminal
blocks.body:
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
git commit --no-verify -m "how to skip it when you must"

proof.note: Git behaves the way you configured it, on every repo.

doneWhen: Your muscle memory is aliases, and your hooks catch what you keep doing wrong.

lessons.title: Find Action for every git command
lessons.teach: Ctrl+Shift+A and type "rebase", "stash", "tag", "reset". Every git operation the IDE has is here with its shortcut shown next to it — the fastest way to stop hunting through the VCS menu.
